items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: See, it was first Cab Calloway and the Missourians. So he wanted to change it to Cab Calloway and His Orchestra, like all the other big shots. So we said... We agreed to let him take the band.

ctx.x: Now, when did the band change to Cab's? You're still the Missourians as we...

Well, we was playing in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. So Cab had got so big then, he was getting... He was getting to be the star of the band. So he called us all in a meeting. He said, 'Well, I'm going to either take over the band, or I'm gonna fire all you all and get me another band.' We was makin' more money, and we had never made that kind of money no way. So what's the big deal if he wanted to change it to Cab Calloway? See, it was first Cab Calloway and the Missourians. So he wanted to change it to Cab…
Now, who is there? Lamar Wright was there...
